scope: Exact AIJADE stage.js code, with only renderer import bindings substituted in a controlled Node DOM fixture. Native renderer/model/voice traffic is assessed separately.

change: A valid new mount supersedes the prior one. A delayed disposal may only unmount the canvas it owns. An absent canvas does not destroy an active stage. A stale resolved renderer is released once. A transient host that only fits an image never requests stage teardown.
asyncInteropBoundary: A transient host loading the browser module when disposed awaits and releases that module reference, then no longer dispatches a mount. Disconnected JS interop keeps the app teardown semantics.
